tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Unicorn Lab's live catalogue for scented cuticle oils, pens, refill pouches, nail decals, tools, and packs, with live AU/NZ/UK/CA pricing and variant URLs.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Retrieve complete product details, variants, sizes, SKU codes, live AU/NZ/UK/CA pricing, and cart-ready variant IDs by product handle (e.g. 'bubblegum-unicorn-cuticle-oil') or Shopify Product GID.

tools.name: lookup_products
tools.description: Resolve 1 to 10 Unicorn Lab products by their Shopify Product GIDs in a single call with live AU/NZ/UK/CA pricing and stock status.

tools.name: ask_store_assistant
tools.description: Ask general questions about Unicorn Lab's cuticle oil collection, scent profiles, Australian manufacturing, dispatch, and storefront ordering.

tools.name: search_policies_and_faqs
tools.description: Retrieve Unicorn Lab's official written store policies and FAQs including domestic/international shipping, returns, privacy policy, terms of service, and contact details.

tools.name: build_cart_link
tools.description: Create a verified Unicorn Lab Shopify cart permalink for the selected variant IDs and quantities so the buyer can review items and complete checkout in their browser.
